headline: Senate Impeachment Court Cancels August 18 Session Amid Monsoon Flooding
seoTitle: Impeachment Trial Aug. 18 Session Canceled Amid Floods | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News overnight brief reports that the Senate Impeachment Court canceled its August 18 session because of severe monsoon flooding in Metro Manila.
deck: The weather-related reset interrupts the trial calendar as flooding affects access to the Senate complex.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News overnight package reports that the Senate sitting as an Impeachment Court canceled the trial session scheduled for Tuesday, August 18, because severe monsoon rains and flooding disrupted Metro Manila travel.
The package says proceedings were reset for Wednesday, August 19.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The cancellation followed the Palace extension of alternative government work arrangements during the same weather emergency. The package attributes the trial-calendar decision to the Senate Impeachment Court and its presiding officer.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A weather-driven delay affects witness scheduling and the pace of a nationally consequential constitutional proceeding while reducing travel risk for court personnel, lawyers and witnesses.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the Senate Impeachment Court for the next formal session notice, witness schedule and any further weather-related changes.
